description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of two methods, "Standard" and "Ours", across three categories: Base, CORG, and an unlabeled category. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the average performance, labeled as such, with a linear scale ranging from 48 to 62, and tick labels at intervals of 2. Each category is represented by a pair of bars, with "Standard" colored grey and "Ours" colored blue. The "Base" category has both bars at approximately 59, the "CORG" category has the "Standard" bar at around 51 and the "Ours" bar at about 59, and the unlabeled category has both bars at roughly 53 and 60.5, respectively. The bars are grouped by category, with the "Standard" and "Ours" bars appearing side by side. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the categories, and no bars are visually emphasized.
